core_memory.user_warranty_inquiry: Michael is concerned about warranty length and service support, especially for higher-end models. He has had negative experiences with short warranties from other brands and wants assurance of reliable, long-term support.

core_memory.michael_membership_model_inquiry: Michael is asking about the current subscription or membership program structure. core_memory.michael_streamlined_purchasing_inquiry: Michael wants streamlined purchasing: one-click ordering, bundled access, and free sample-size coffee flavors or discount codes on future machines.
